The [b]free DLC[/b] with the MULTIPLAYER mode for First Strike is here! [h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331550/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=steampost&utm_content=linkenglish&utm_campaign=multiplayerrelease]PLAY IT NOW[/url][/h1]

Don't forget to update the main game, the DLC only works with the latest version of First Strike. It's good to have your Steam Cloud settings activated for First Strike, so that your save file stays secured, while the app gets updated.

Tell your friends and challenge each other to nuclear war battles!

[h2]PLEASE NOTE: Keyboard shortcuts are disabled in multiplayer[/h2]

The [u]keyboard shortcuts are deactivated[/u] in the multiplayer on purpose. The multiplayer has crossplay, which means PC players and mobile players play together. The shortcuts would be a big advantage for PC players and make it unfair for mobile players. Disabling shortcuts was a necessary compromise. The PC player base is not big enough to not have crossplay, so we have to mix the players and make it at least fair for everyone.

notes.title: First Strike is evolving on mobile!
notes.notes:
Dear First Strike fans

You have been training on your fancy gaming rigs, it is time to prove your warfare skills on the upcoming mobile device battlefield.

We want to inform you that the free mobile version of First Strike is evolving with new content. We just released The Daily Conflict Update that includes [b]seven new daily challenge modes[/b]! And we plan to continue on expanding the free mobile version of the game with more new gameplay content in the future.

Now some of you who play First Strike primarily on your PC may be asking: “[i]But what about First Strike on Steam? I want to play the new content on my PC and not on a mobile device.[/i]”

Here we have to tell you that the Steam version will not get these new updates. We plan to keep the Steam version as it is because it is supposed to provide [b]the typical, essential First Strike experience[/b], hence the “Classic” title. The free mobile version on the other hand is our "nuclear playground" where we now experiment with new gameplay material. At the moment, a free Steam version of the game with the new content isn’t planned.

If you want to try out the new content and you have an Android or iOS device, you can easily get the free mobile version on the [url=https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1434281598?mt=8]Apple App Store[/url] and on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.blindflugstudios.firststrike.free&hl]Google Play Store[/url].

We hope you will continue to enjoy First Strike in its pure, iconic form here on Steam, as well in its new, evolving form on your mobile devices.

With kind regards

The Blindflug Studios team

PS: You can follow us on our [url=https://www.instagram.com/first_strike_game/]First Strike Instagram[/url] to get more First Strike news. We're currently doing a week-long T-shirt giveaway there!

notes.title: 7 Years of First Strike
notes.notes:
On this day, seven years ago, the first version of First Strike was released. A tiny game from a small development team with just the simple wish of creating a fast and frantic strategy game, that also shows to the world, how devastating our nuclear arsenal truly is. 

The rest is history: First Strike was the game that started our company and kept us going for over seven years now. Over 11 Million players have played First Strike to this day across all platforms. We owe the bomb a ton. But most of all, we are here thanks to all of you. Thank you so much!

Celebrate this historic day with us: We are going to stream live from the Blindflug Hangar on Twitch at 19.00 CET. It would be great if you join us when we play the brand new First Strike: Classic remaster of the original game. 
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/blindflugstudio]Blindflug Studios on Twitch[/url]

For those who cannot access Twitch, stay right here. We will also mirror the livestream here on the Steam Store page, so stay tuned if you want to watch along.

Want to celebrate with other First Strike players? Check out our celebration page right here. It has the links to Discord and the First Strike Facebook page.
[url=https://firststrike.mobi/nuclear-war-celebration-day]Blindflug Celebration Hub Page[/url]

Hope to see you all and thank you all for your support over the years!

notes.title: First Strike: Classic Remaster Update
notes.notes:
Hello dear tactical annihilators from all around the world!

Today we have a special announcement to make. First Strike: Final Hour will get a massive update today, becoming First Strike: Classic.

Why is that? Well, you see, this Saturday, First Strike is turning 7 years old. And for this special celebration we did something special: We used the last months during the global lockdowns to remaster the whole game from the ground up.

First Strike: Classic is a new rebuild of the original First Strike, including:
[list]
[*] A new codebase completely rebuilt from the ground up to fight bugs 
[*] A massively smarter AI with brand new behaviors 
[*] Newly refreshed and redesigned interface 
[*] And it is free of charge as an update for all First Strike fans
[/list]

We’ve heard the feedback that First Strike was having some issues lately. Not only is this version more merciless and sleeker than ever before, we also hope this update will help to make First Strike ready for another nuclear decade.

If you are interested in celebrating the anniversary with us, join the festivities this Saturday when we're doing a special livestream with the community. All the links are on this hub page:
[url=https://firststrike.mobi/nuclear-war-celebration-day]Nuclear Celebration Day HUB[/url]

Thank you all for sticking with First Strike for so long and we hope you are having a ton of fun with this remaster and with figuring out the creative ways to blow up the world.

Remember: The only winning move is not to play.... or is it?

notes.title: The new game from the First Strike developers - Now available!
notes.notes:
[h3]Stellar Commanders is a fast-paced multiplayer real-time strategy game that pits player against player in a bid to take control of distant planets as part of an inter-galactic war for precious resources. Aim for the Stars! Enjoy your First Strike experience together with your friends![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1165400/Stellar_Commanders/

[h3]The speedy 1 vs 1 battles will see each player align with a different faction and choose units based on a deep roster of unlockable futuristic troops; from rockets, tanks and stealth generators to bombastic orbital satellites, all of which will help determine tactical decisions.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=sJoXV8cG2K8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]This is our first multiplayer strategy game and one that we’ve been excited about for some time – it seemed like a perfect next step after the huge success of First Strike. Combining the First Strike community’s feedback about making a multiplayer strategy title with our own love of ‘90s RTS games has resulted in Stellar Commanders, which will have all the fast-paced fun of a modern, tactical RTS as well as a touch of nostalgia.[/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1165400/Stellar_Commanders/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1165400/extras/overview1_gif.gif?t=1580479667[/img][/url]

notes.title: First Strike: Final Hour now out on iOS and Android!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28290267/187f33c88dee4473601093f3827750b0d3abce84.jpg[/img]

You want to play First Strike: Final Hour on the train, on the toilet, on a horse? No problemo, we release a FREE update for the original First Strike on iOS and Android, so you can use the Trident wherever you are. 

For Android we release an additional FREE version with the same content, but powered with ads. Have no money for First Strike: Final Hour? Just get this new version on the Google Play store. 

The features which you already enjoyed, but are new to the mobile version:

- 6 New Super Weapons
Burning enemy silos down or dropping their nukes from the sky; the new super weapons give lots of new strategic options.

- New Non-Attack-Pact-System
Players can now form non-attack treaties with superpowers and - if they want to - stab them in the back.

- Enhanced Graphics
New high resolution texture reworks including night lights, normal maps and star constellations.

- Save Game & 7 New Languages
First Strike now saves the game when it quits, so players can continue where they left off. Also, it’s now localized in Italian, Polish, Swedish, Ukrainian, Japanese, Korean and Thai.


Watch the trailer here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MCHKPWFuhho

notes.title: What a wonderful launch, Thank you very much!
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for making us have such a wonderful launch weekend!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28290267/a4a7143dce9178834772d6012037871aa1193846.jpg[/img]

First Strike: Final Hour started really well on Steam and everyone at Blindflug is so happy with the reception. It seems there are a lot of you longtime fans instantly playing Final Hour on day one, even though you already know the game from back on mobile. It makes us very proud to see in the reviews that you are happy with the results ːsteamhappyː

We're also incredibly humbled by the ammount of you who actually bought the deluxe version. We never thought so many of you would pay the extra bucks for the Soundtrack and the Design Document/Retro Boxes/Wallpaper Pack. This helps us, but especially the Music Artist [url=http://www.michelbarengo.com] Michel Barengo [/url] out a big lot. (He also wants to say thank you that you made the "Great Soundtrack" tag happen). Thank you so much!

There is one more thing we can announce. We dont wanna ask for more money, we just want to let you know, because its something we wanted for a long time. People often asked us to make similar shirts than the ones we wear at conventions (like the ones in the picture above). But that was impossible because we did them all locally here and they would have cost over 60$. So we decided opened up our own [url=https://blindflugstudios.threadless.com] Blindflug Threadless Artist Store [/url] yesterday ːfseyeopenː

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28290267/63d470810eabc3a74a34d29342446e0ae26e29bf.png[/img]

We've remastered a series of all [url=https://blindflugstudios.threadless.com/collections/first-strike-final-hour-t-shirts-series-1/] five Superweapon Shirts [/url] we wore on exhibitions for First Strike Around the world. They have new special color highlights, making them even a bit prettier than the team shirts. We hope you like the designs, we'd love to hear what you think of them.

Again, thank you very much for all the nice words. This makes all the work so much worthwhile ːsteamhappyː

- Olga, Michael, Moritz, Frédéric, Sophie, Urs & Jeremy
